bodyText.title: TBA Academy empowers students with skills that go far beyond the classroom.
bodyText.description: We specialize in teaching public speaking, debate, Model United Nations (MUN), and mock trial to students of all skill levels. Our programs help develop critical thinking, communication skills, and confidence in public speaking.

studentQuote.text: I love debate because it's introduced me to an amazing community. I've met a lot of outstanding people, especially during in person tournaments and classes. Debate has taught me two really important things. One, I've expanded my knowledge around politics and current events, but two and most importantly, I've learned to always think critically and with an open mind during discussions.

infoSection.title: Excellence in Education
infoSection.subtitle: Building Tomorrow's Leaders
infoSection.description1: At TBA Academy, we believe in fostering debate excellence while nurturing well-rounded students. Our comprehensive programs are designed to challenge students intellectually while providing them with the critical thinking and communication skills they need to succeed in an ever-changing world.
infoSection.description2: Our dedicated coaches are committed to creating an engaging learning environment where every student can thrive and reach their full potential. We emphasize logical reasoning, persuasive communication, and collaborative problem-solving in all aspects of our educational approach.
infoSection.description3: With proven debate methodologies and innovative teaching techniques, we prepare students not just for competitive success, but for life beyond the classroom.

section1.title: TBA started in 2018 as a small group of enthusiastic students who wanted to learn more about debate and public speaking.
section1.content: Today TBA Academy has inspired many students to become successful in their future careers. With over 100 concurrent students, TBA is one of the largest and most successful debate and public speaking academies in the area. We continue to grow every day with 3 locations in the greater Vancouver area to allow all students to have access to our programs.

section2.title: Our Vision
section2.content: To be the leading force in developing the next generation of critical thinkers, confident communicators, and global leaders. We envision a world where every student has the opportunity to develop their voice, challenge assumptions, and contribute meaningfully to society through the power of debate, public speaking, and international diplomacy. Our commitment extends beyond academic excellence to fostering empathy, cultural understanding, and the courage to stand up for what they believe in.

programs.pageSubtitle: Discover our comprehensive curriculum designed to develop critical thinking, leadership skills, and academic excellence in students of all ages.

section1.title: Comprehensive Debate Training for All Skill Levels
section1.content: Our debate program is designed to develop critical thinking, persuasive communication, and public speaking skills. Students learn various debate formats including British Parliamentary, World Schools, and Canadian Parliamentary styles. Through structured competitions, practice sessions, and expert coaching, students build confidence and master the art of effective argumentation.

section2.title: Why Choose Debate?
section2.content: Debate students develop essential life skills including research abilities, logical reasoning, and the confidence to speak in front of audiences. Our program has produced numerous champions at local, national, and international competitions. Students learn to think on their feet, construct compelling arguments, and respectfully engage with opposing viewpoints.

coaches.title: Our Head Coaches
coaches.description: Our team includes WUDC top speakers, numerous champions from top tournaments, national team members, and national team coaches, among other distinguished debaters.

section1.title: Experience the Legal System Through Interactive Simulations
section1.content: Our Mock Trial program provides students with hands-on experience in the legal system through realistic courtroom simulations. Students learn to analyze legal cases, develop arguments, and present evidence in a structured trial environment. The program covers criminal and civil law procedures, helping students understand how the justice system works while developing critical thinking and public speaking skills.

section2.title: Why Choose Mock Trial?
section2.content: Mock Trial participants develop essential skills including legal reasoning, evidence analysis, persuasive argumentation, and courtroom etiquette. Students gain confidence in public speaking, learn to think critically under pressure, and develop a deep understanding of legal principles. Our program prepares students for future careers in law, politics, or any field requiring analytical thinking and strong communication skills.

section1.title: Experience International Diplomacy and Global Leadership
section1.content: Our Model United Nations program offers students the opportunity to experience international diplomacy and global issues through United Nations simulations and committee work. Students represent different countries, research complex global challenges, and develop solutions through negotiation, debate, and collaboration with peers from around the world.

section2.title: Why Choose Model UN?
section2.content: Model UN participants develop essential skills including research methodology, public speaking, negotiation, and global awareness. Students learn about international relations, current events, and the United Nations system. The program fosters leadership, critical thinking, and the ability to work effectively in diverse teams while addressing real-world global challenges.

section1.title: 4-in-1 Full Range Debating for Grades 4-7
section1.content: This course is designed for younger students in Grades 4 to 7. Unlike a typical debate or public speaking class, it integrates both approaches with a Model United Nations component and a news analysis component. It offers a well-rounded and balanced experience, giving students a taste of each area.

section2.title: Why Choose 4-in-1?
section2.content: This comprehensive approach allows students to explore what they enjoy and what they don't. Sometimes, a student may excel in one area and choose to pursue it further, even if they hadn't previously taken a specific class in that subject, such as MUN. Students develop foundational skills across multiple disciplines while discovering their passions and strengths.

section1.title: Introduction to Business Problem-Solving
section1.content: The case competition course is designed to introduce students to the world of business problem-solving and how to deliver strong presentations to prepare them for competing in competitions.

section2.title: Why Choose Business Case Competition?
section2.content: Students develop essential business analysis skills including strategic thinking, market research, financial analysis, and professional presentation techniques. Our program prepares students for real-world business challenges and competitive case competitions at the local, national, and international levels.

section1.title: Advanced In-Person Learning Experience
section1.content: The Friday Workshop is held on select Fridays each semester and meets in-person, similar to debate clubs at Canadian universities. The workshop is structured into two sections. The first section is a seminar prepared by coaches on specific debate-related topics. Unlike the regular topics discussed in online classes, the in-person topics are more advanced and sophisticated.

section2.title: Why Choose Friday Workshops?
section2.content: The second section involves practice debates where students are grouped into teams to debate against each other. This familiarizes them with in-person debating and prepares them for in-person tournaments. Students develop advanced debate skills, build confidence in face-to-face communication, and gain valuable tournament preparation experience.

section1.title: Weekly Video News Summaries with Context
section1.content: TBA's News Channel provides a video summary of the week's most important news stories, along with context to help students understand why they are happening and what they mean for the world. Each video combines multiple news stories about a single topic to give students a balanced overview of events. The videos incorporate up-to-date news with historical background and analysis to provide viewers with a sense of what is at stake.

section2.title: Why Choose News Analysis?
section2.content: This is especially beneficial for students who study debate and participate in debate competitions, as it helps them stay informed about current events and gain valuable facts, insights, and perspectives. Students develop critical media literacy skills, learn to analyze complex global issues, and build a strong foundation of current events knowledge essential for debate success.

section1.title: Junior Science Olympiad for Top Intermediate Students
section1.content: Designed to provide top intermediate science students (12- 15 years old) the opportunity to enhance and test their theoretical and practical lab skills in Chemistry, Physics and Biology. Studentts who attend this class typically grow their interest in science and develop a strong foundation of science knowledge.

section2.title: Why Choose JSOC?
section2.content: The top 6 students will represent Canada at the International Junior Science Olympiad. The Stage 1 exam usually takes place in February, and the Stage 2 exam in May. Top students will qualify for the National Camp in September. After attending the camp, students will take the Stage 3 qualifying exam to compete for the six spots on the National Team.

section1.title: Canadian National Neuroscience Competition
section1.content: The Canadian National Brain Bee is a neuroscience competition for high school students, grades 9 through 12. Students study brain and neuroscience research topics including memory, sleep, intelligence, emotion, perception, stress, aging, brain imaging, neurology, neurotransmitters, genetics, brain disease, and more.

section2.title: Why Choose Brain Bee?
section2.content: To compete in the Canadian National, students must first compete in a regional brain bee competition in Canada. The top place winner of each official regional brain bee will advance to the Canadian National level of competition. Finally, the top place champion of the Canadian National Brain Bee will advance to the next level of competition: the International Brain Bee. The Vancouver Brain Bee is usually held in late April.
